entry.title: πMorpH 0.1.0
entry.summary: # πMorpH 0.1.0 First public Force Gen1 / ARMv7 release. - Eight-voice XY wavetable synthesis with a per-voice path and orbit. - Independent amplitude/filter envelopes, MS-style HP/LP filters, eleven LFO shapes and eight modulation routes. - Precise cached graphical previews, compact panels over a dimmed current screen, yellow opening selectors and 36 px panel choices. - 294 Adventure Kid wavetable sounds plus INIT in the native PRESET menu. - French and English manuals with native Force screensh
